description: This Java source file defines the EventSenderImpl class, which is a concrete implementation of a client for publishing event messages to a Hono server using Vertx-Proton. It includes methods for creating instances, generating target addresses, and sending messages with delivery semantics.

classes.name: EventSenderImpl
classes.description: A Vertx-Proton based client for publishing event messages to a Hono server, extending AbstractDownstreamSender, providing mechanisms to create sender instances and send messages with tracing support.

methods.name: getTargetAddress
methods.description: Constructs the target address string for a given tenant and device ID.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the event endpoint constant string.

methods.name: getTo
methods.description: Returns the complete target address for a specific device ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new EventSenderImpl instance, establishing a sender connection to the Hono server for a specific tenant.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for its delivery outcome with at least once semantics.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome (overloaded with parent SpanContext)
methods.description: Sends a message with a specific tracing parent span and waits for the outcome.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message with durable property set to true, tracking tracing span, and waits for acceptance.

methods.name: startSpan
methods.description: Creates and starts a new tracing span for forwarding an event, with producer span kind.
